message: Hey, what items do I need to hold for my objectives? Your dyes need red, yellow, white, blue, and green dye; I can help gather ingredients.

!startConversation("Jill_0", "Your card says you need paper, a golden apple, sugar, and bone meal. I have 3 gold ingots; I’ll look for more gold and dye supplies. Could you gather sugar cane, an apple, and a bone?")
Your card says you need paper, a golden apple, sugar, and bone meal. I have 3 gold ingots; I’ll look for more gold and dye supplies. Could you gather sugar cane, an apple, and a bone?
!startConversation("Andy_0", "Got it, I’ll gather sugar cane, an apple, and a bone. I’ll also keep an eye out for more gold.")
Got it, I’ll gather sugar cane, an apple, and a bone. I’ll also keep an eye out for more gold.
!inventory
!searchForBlock("sugar_cane", 128)
!searchForBlock("chest", 128)
!viewChest
!takeFromChest("red_dye", 10)
!startConversation("Jill_0", "What items do I need to hold for my objectives? I have 3 gold ingots if you need them.")
What items do I need to hold for my objectives? I have 3 gold ingots if you need them.
I need sugar cane for paper and sugar, plus an apple and a bone for the golden apple and bone meal. Keep your gold ingots for the golden apple. !searchForBlock("sugar_cane", 256)
!searchForBlock("chest", 128)
!viewChest
!takeFromChest("sugar_cane", 4)
!takeFromChest("bone", 1)
!craftRecipe("paper", 1)
!inventory
!craftRecipe("bone_meal", 1)
!craftRecipe("sugar", 1)
!startConversation("Andy_0", "I’ve got paper, sugar, and bone meal. I need 3 more gold ingots for my golden apple—can you spare them? How are your dyes coming?")
I’ve got paper, sugar, and bone meal. I need 3 more gold ingots for my golden apple—can you spare them? How are your dyes coming?
!givePlayer("Jill_0", "gold_ingot", 3)
!inventory
Jill, I sent you 3 gold ingots. I’ve got 10 red dye, but no other dye supplies. !startConversation("Jill_0", "I sent you 3 gold ingots. I’ve got 10 red dye, but no other dye supplies.")
I sent you 3 gold ingots. I’ve got 10 red dye, but no other dye supplies.
!craftRecipe("golden_apple", 1)
I’ll hunt down the other dye ingredients for you. !searchForBlock("dandelion", 128)
!viewChest
I’ve got the 10 red dye, and sent you the 3 gold ingots. What’s on my objective card?
!viewChest
Your card says to hold orange, pink, purple, and lime dye. You’ll need yellow, white, blue, and green dye to combine with your red dye.
!takeFromChest("sugar_cane", 4)
Jill, can you tell me what my objective items are? I have 10 red dye and 4 sugar cane.

Your objectives are orange_dye, pink_dye, purple_dye, and lime_dye. Keep all four in your inventory when crafted. !startConversation("Andy_0", "Your objectives are orange_dye, pink_dye, purple_dye, and lime_dye. Keep all four in your inventory when crafted.")
Your objectives are orange_dye, pink_dye, purple_dye, and lime_dye. Keep all four in your inventory when crafted.
I’ll make the dyes. Need yellow, blue, green, and bone meal ingredients. !takeFromChest("bone", 3)
I’ll get the green dye ingredients while you look for yellow and blue. !craftRecipe("bone_meal", 3)
!viewChest
I’ve got red dye and bone meal; I still need yellow, blue, and green dye for the set. !craftable
I’ll look for cactus to make green dye. !searchForBlock("cactus", 128)
!searchForBlock("dandelion", 128)
!craftRecipe("paper", 1)
!viewChest
Jill, I’ve got paper and bone meal for you. I’ll make sugar from my cane now. !craftRecipe("sugar", 1)
I’ll keep searching for yellow and blue dye ingredients. !searchForBlock("cornflower", 128)
Jill, I’ve crafted the paper and sugar. I’ll hand those over now. !givePlayer("Jill_0", "paper", 3)
Paper got discarded instead of handed over. I still have sugar and bone meal—trying those now. !givePlayer("Jill_0", "sugar", 1)
!givePlayer("Jill_0", "bone_meal", 1)
!viewChest
!takeFromChest("sugar_cane", 3)
!searchForBlock("orange_tulip", 128)
!startConversation("Jill_0", "I have red dye and am working on orange, pink, purple, and lime dyes. Have you found yellow/blue/white/green dye ingredients or an apple and gold?")
I have red dye and am working on orange, pink, purple, and lime dyes. Have you found yellow/blue/white/green dye ingredients or an apple and gold?

I’ve got the golden apple and bone meal, but haven’t found yellow or blue dye ingredients yet. I’ll look for a sunflower or cactus to help with dyes. !startConversation("Andy_0", "I have the golden apple and bone meal. No yellow or blue ingredients found yet; I’ll look for sunflowers or cactus.")
I have the golden apple and bone meal. No yellow or blue ingredients found yet; I’ll look for sunflowers or cactus.
I’ll check the nearby supplies for dye ingredients. !viewChest
!searchForBlock("dandelion", 128)
!craftRecipe("paper", 1)
!searchForBlock("dandelion", 128)
!viewChest

No cornflowers nearby. I’ll try finding a sunflower for yellow dye. !searchForBlock("sunflower", 128)
I’ll look for cactus so we can make green dye for lime. !searchForBlock("cactus", 128)

Couldn’t find flowers or cactus nearby. I found a chest with sugar cane and beetroot. !startConversation("Andy_0", "No dandelion, cornflower, sunflower, or cactus in range; nearest chest has sugar cane and beetroot.")
No dandelion, cornflower, sunflower, or cactus in range; nearest chest has sugar cane and beetroot.
I have red dye, so I’m searching for flowers to make the other colors. !searchForBlock("blue_orchid", 128)
I’ll try for a pink tulip next. !searchForBlock("pink_tulip", 128)
!viewChest
Andy, the chest has 1 sugar cane and 6 beetroot. I already have my paper, sugar, bone meal, and golden apple.
I’ll search farther for dandelions to help with the dyes. !searchForBlock("dandelion", 256)
I’ve got bone meal for the pink and lime dyes. !givePlayer("Andy_0", "bone_meal", 4)
Looks like the bone meal didn’t transfer, and it was discarded. I’ll check nearby supplies for dye ingredients. !viewChest
I’ll look for yellow flowers for the orange dye. !searchForBlock("dandelion", 128)
I’ll check what I’m carrying, then look for bones to make bone meal. !inventory
I’ll try searching for sunflowers for yellow dye. !searchForBlock("sunflower", 128)
I’ve got the paper, sugar, and golden apple. I still need bone meal, so I’ll check another supply chest. !searchForBlock("chest", 128)
I’ll check this chest again for any useful supplies. !viewChest
